import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse
import compiler.compiler as C

def compile_policy(text, cols):
    rules, a, p = parse(text)
    expr = C.language(rules, cols)
    t, acc = C.automaton(expr, len(cols))
    cls = C.minimize(t, acc)
    return C.canonical(t, acc, cls, len(cols))

cols = {'A':0, 'B':1}
tests = [
 ("", cols),
 ("match(A) allow;", cols),
 ("match(A) allow; match(A) drop;", cols),
 ("startswith(A) allow;", cols),
 ("endswith(A) allow;", cols),
 ("contains(A,B) allow;", cols),
 ("not(contains(A)) allow;", cols),
 ("match(A,B) allow; match(B,A) allow;", cols),
 ("(match(A) or match(B)) and not(match(A)) allow;", cols),
 ("contains(A) drop; startswith(B) allow;", cols),
 ("match() allow;", cols),
 ("startswith() allow;", cols),
 ("contains() drop; match(A) allow;", cols),
]
for text, c in tests:
    flags, rows = compile_policy(text, c)
    print(repr(text), '->', flags, rows)
EOF
